lines: --- Read-only SQL for chat (data_query). The model writes one SELECT over the owner's finance records.
--- It runs as moneo_reader, a role that can only read the views in moneo_query: an allowlist of finance
--- tables and columns. Bank and Scalable tokens, service keys, settings, chats, auth and storage have no
--- view, so they can't be named. Each view keeps to the caller's workspace and the AI data scopes from
--- Settings through pg_temp.moneo_query_scope, which data_query fills before the query runs and the query
--- can't change. lib/ai/data-query.ts describes these views to the model; keep the two in step.
-do $$ begin
-  if not exists (select 1 from pg_roles where rolname = 'moneo_reader') then
-    create role moneo_reader nologin noinherit;
-  end if;
-end $$;
--- The migration role owns moneo_query.run below, so it needs to be able to hand ownership over.
-grant moneo_reader to postgres;
-create schema if not exists moneo_query;
-revoke all on schema moneo_query from public;
-grant usage on schema moneo_query to authenticated, moneo_reader;
--- The workspace a query may read, when the view's scope is allowed. Runs as the reader.
-create or replace function moneo_query.workspace_for(p_scope text) returns uuid
-language plpgsql stable security invoker set search_path = '' as $$
-declare v_workspace uuid; v_scopes text[];
-begin
-  select s.workspace_id, s.scopes into v_workspace, v_scopes from pg_temp.moneo_query_scope s;
-  if v_workspace is null then raise exception 'moneo_query views are only readable through data_query' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
-  if not p_scope = any(v_scopes) then
-    raise exception '% data is turned off for the AI in Settings', p_scope using errcode = '42501';
-  end if;
-  return v_workspace;
-end $$;
-revoke all on function moneo_query.workspace_for(text) from public;
-grant execute on function moneo_query.workspace_for(text) to moneo_reader;
-create or replace view moneo_query.accounts as
-  select a.id, a.name, a.type, a.currency_code, a.archived_at, a.created_at
-  from public.accounts a where a.workspace_id = moneo_query.workspace_for('accounts');
-create or replace view moneo_query.balance_snapshots as
-  select b.id, b.account_id, b.amount_minor, b.currency_code, b.as_of, b.provenance, b.balance_type, b.created_at
-  from public.balance_snapshots b where b.workspace_id = moneo_query.workspace_for('accounts') and b.undone_at is null;
-create or replace view moneo_query.categories as
-  select c.id, c.name from public.categories c where c.workspace_id = moneo_query.workspace_for('transactions');
-create or replace view moneo_query.merchants as
-  select m.id, m.name from public.merchants m where m.workspace_id = moneo_query.workspace_for('transactions');
-create or replace view moneo_query.transactions as
-  select t.id, t.account_id, t.posted_on, t.posted_at, t.description, t.amount_minor, t.currency_code, t.status, t.kind,
-    t.category_id, t.merchant_id, t.tags, t.event_name, t.note, t.transfer_id, t.refund_of_id, t.created_at
-  from public.transactions t where t.workspace_id = moneo_query.workspace_for('transactions');
-create or replace view moneo_query.transaction_splits as
-  select s.id, s.parent_transaction_id, s.category_id, s.amount_minor, t.currency_code, s.note, s.ordinal
-  from public.transaction_splits s
-  join public.transaction_split_sets ss on ss.id = s.split_set_id and ss.undone_at is null
-  join public.transactions t on t.id = s.parent_transaction_id

-Get the owner what they actually wanted, end to end. Infer what they mean from the conversation and their records, and act on it instead of asking them to do the looking.

Match the way a person would, but a close name alone is not a match: its amount, currency and direction must fit what the owner said too. With one clear match, use it and say which. When several fit, name them and ask which one in one short question.
-- Follow the conversation. "her", "that one" and "same for March" refer to what was just discussed. When the owner corrects you, redo the step with the correction straight away.
-- Notice what matters. If you see the loan is already recorded, a repayment arrived, or a payment looks doubled, say so in one sentence.
-# Constraints
-- Never invent or estimate transactions, balances or amounts. If the records can't answer, say what is missing and where they can add it.

+create or replace function public.data_query(p_sql text, p_scopes text[], p_max_rows integer default 500) returns jsonb
+language plpgsql volatile security invoker set search_path = '' set statement_timeout = '5s' as $$
+declare
+  v_workspace uuid; v_sql text := pg_catalog.btrim(coalesce(p_sql, '')); v_result jsonb; v_error text;
+begin
+  select w.id into v_workspace from public.workspaces w where w.owner_id = auth.uid();
+  if v_workspace is null then raise exception 'No workspace for this user' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
+  if p_scopes is null or not p_scopes <@ array['accounts','transactions','planning','imports'] then
+    raise exception 'Unknown AI data scope' using errcode = '22023';
+  end if;
+  v_sql := pg_catalog.regexp_replace(v_sql, ';\s*$', '');
+  if v_sql = '' or pg_catalog.length(v_sql) > 8000 then return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('error', 'The query must be 1 to 8000 characters.'); end if;
+  if pg_catalog.strpos(v_sql, ';') > 0 then return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('error', 'Send exactly one SELECT statement, without semicolons.'); end if;
+  begin
+    create temp table moneo_query_scope (workspace_id uuid not null, scopes text[] not null) on commit drop;
+    insert into pg_temp.moneo_query_scope values (v_workspace, p_scopes);
+    grant select on pg_temp.moneo_query_scope to moneo_reader;
+    perform pg_catalog.set_config('transaction_read_only', 'on', true);
+    v_result := moneo_query.run(v_sql, least(greatest(coalesce(p_max_rows, 500), 1), 500), 200000);
+    raise exception using errcode = 'MQ000';
+  exception
+    when sqlstate 'MQ000' then null;
+    when query_canceled then v_error := 'The query took longer than 5 seconds. Narrow it with filters or aggregate.';
+    when others then v_error := sqlerrm;
+  end;
+  if v_error is not null then return pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('error', v_error); end if;
+  return v_result;
+end $$;
+revoke all on function public.data_query(text, text[], integer) from public, anon;
+grant execute on function public.data_query(text, text[], integer) to authenticated;

lines: -# Moneo

-Moneo is an open-source personal finance app that runs on your own computer. Import bank statements or sync your bank, track accounts and wealth, plan spending, and ask questions about your money in chat or on a voice call. Figures always come from your own records; the AI explains them and suggests changes that you accept.
-Website: **[indkhan.github.io/Moneo](https://indkhan.github.io/Moneo/)** — screenshots, what Moneo does, and the right installer for your computer.

-Everything stays on your computer. There are no accounts and no sign-in screen: one owner, one workspace. The only data that leaves your computer goes to the services you connect (your AI provider, and optionally your bank or Scalable Capital).
-## Install
-### Desktop preview

-Desktop installers for Windows, macOS and Linux are attached to [GitHub releases](https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo/releases) once published (none is published yet; until then, use the source installation below): download, install and open Moneo; nothing else is needed. Settings → App updates installs newer releases and keeps your data. See [desktop setup and operation](desktop/README.md) for packaging, data locations, backups and signing requirements. The desktop app bundles its local backend and does not require Docker or Node.js. The source installation below remains supported.

-Scalable questions in chat and voice can combine live holdings, paginated transaction history and transaction details with local JavaScript calculations. The calculation sandbox has no network, filesystem or credentials. Read results remain subject to your AI data scopes and are sent to your configured AI provider as needed to answer. Trades still require accepting an approval card. No additional setup is needed.
-### Easiest: let an AI agent install it
-If you use an AI coding agent such as Claude Code or Codex, it can do the install for you with the `moneo-setup` skill that comes with Moneo. Open the agent in an empty folder and paste:
-> Clone https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo, then set it up by following .agents/skills/moneo-setup/SKILL.md in that repository.

-If you already downloaded Moneo, open the agent in the Moneo folder and say **"set up Moneo"**. The agent runs the commands, tells you what each step does, and asks you only for what it can't do itself, like installing Docker or entering your keys in Moneo. If it can control your browser or computer, it asks first and then does the clicking too. You type passwords and keys yourself.
-### Or install it yourself
-#### 1. Install the tools
-- [Git](https://git-scm.com/downloads)
-- [Node.js](https://nodejs.org) version 22 or newer
-- [Docker Desktop](https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/) (on Linux, Docker Engine with Compose)
-Start Docker Desktop and wait until it says it is running.
-#### 2. Download Moneo
-git clone https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo.git
-cd Moneo
-npm ci
-#### 3. Run the setup
-npm run setup

-This creates the database in Docker, makes all the passwords and secrets Moneo needs, and saves them in a file called `.env`. The first run downloads a few GB and takes several minutes; you need about 4 GB of free disk space. On Windows a security prompt may ask to install a local certificate: click **Yes** (it is only used for bank connections and only trusted on this computer).
-You never need to open or edit `.env`. Keep it private and don't delete it.
-#### 4. Start Moneo
-npm run build
-npm start
-The build takes a few minutes the first time. Then open **http://localhost:3000**.
-#### 5. Turn on the AI
-Go to **Settings → Keys and connections → AI access** and choose one:
-- **Sign in with ChatGPT** to use your ChatGPT Go, Plus or Pro plan,
-- **Sign in with Claude** to use your Claude Pro, Max, Team or Enterprise plan (see [Use your Claude plan](#use-your-claude-plan-optional)), or
-- **Paste an OpenAI API key** ([create one here](https://platform.openai.com/api-keys)) and click **Save key**. Usage is billed to that key.
-Voice calls and dictation need the OpenAI API key. An OpenRouter key is optional (for other models).
-#### 6. Add your money
-- **Import** a CSV or Excel export from your bank, or
-- connect your bank or Scalable Capital (optional, see below).
-That's it. Want it on your phone or tablet too? See [Use it from your phone or tablet](#use-it-from-your-phone-or-tablet-optional).
-## Everyday use
-- **Start Moneo:** `npm start` in the Moneo folder (Docker Desktop must be running).
-- **Stop Moneo:** press `Ctrl+C`. The database keeps running in Docker; `docker compose stop` stops it.
-- **Update Moneo:**
-  git pull
-  npm ci
-  npm run setup
-  npm run build
-  npm start
-  Your data and secrets are kept.

-While Moneo runs it does its background work by itself: scheduled summaries, and syncing your bank and Scalable about once a day. Anything missed while your computer was off runs shortly after you start Moneo.

-Opening Moneo or coming back to it also syncs in the background (Scalable at most every 15 minutes, banks at most every hour): you see the last numbers right away and the page updates when the sync lands. If a value can't be refreshed, it still counts in your net worth and Wealth marks it as not from today. A short message in the corner of Home tells you once about old values and about a connection that failed or needs reconnecting.
-## Keys and connections

-Every key and outside service is set up in the app under **Settings → Keys and connections**. Keys are checked with the provider before they are saved, stored encrypted in your database, shown only by their last four characters, and can be replaced or removed at any time. The same section shows that the secrets made by `npm run setup` are in place.
-### Use your Claude plan (optional)

-Moneo can run on your Claude subscription instead of an API key. It uses Claude Code, which comes with Moneo, signed in with your own Claude account on this computer. Moneo never sees or stores your Claude login; Claude Code keeps it, the same one the Claude Code app uses.
-1. In **Settings → AI access**, click **Sign in with Claude** on this computer. A Claude sign-in page opens in your browser.
-2. Sign in. If the page shows a code, paste it into Moneo and click **Continue**. If you're already signed in to Claude Code, Moneo shows your account straight away; click **Use Claude plan**.

-Chat, artifacts, briefings, imports and the agents then run on Claude (Opus 5.5 for the chat, Haiku 5.5 for lighter tasks; change them under **Settings → AI and your data → Advanced**). Requests count toward your plan's usage limits, shown at [claude.ai/settings/usage](https://claude.ai/settings/usage).

-- **Never billed to an API key.** Moneo removes `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and similar settings before it starts Claude Code, and only runs Claude when Claude Code is signed in with a Claude plan. If you sign out of Claude Code, AI stays off until you sign in again or pick another option.

-- **Only Moneo's tools.** Claude gets Moneo's finance tools and nothing else: no files, no shell, no other MCP servers, and no chat history saved by Claude Code. Changes still go through cards you accept.
-- **PDFs in chat** are read on your computer and sent to Claude as text. A scanned PDF has no text to read, so attach photos of its pages instead.

+- [Docker Desktop](https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/) (on Linux, Docker Engine with Compose)
+Start Docker Desktop and wait until it says it is running.
+#### 2. Download Moneo
+git clone https://github.com/indkhan/Moneo.git
+cd Moneo
+npm ci
+#### 3. Run the setup
+npm run setup

+This creates the database in Docker, makes all the passwords and secrets Moneo needs, and saves them in a file called `.env`. Add a read-only SQL query function for chat (data_query)

public.data_query runs one SELECT as the signed-in owner through moneo_query.run, a
security-definer function owned by moneo_reader. That role can only read the views in
schema moneo_query: an allowlist of finance tables and columns limited to the caller's
workspace and AI data scopes. Bank and Scalable tokens, service keys, settings, chats,
auth and storage have no view. The query runs read-only in a subtransaction that is
rolled back afterwards, returns at most 500 rows and 200 KB with every number as exact
text, and PostgREST stops it after 5 seconds. Because the query runs inside a
security-definer function it cannot switch role, and changed JWT claims don't move it
to another workspace.

lib/ai/data-query.ts describes the views to the model and exposes runDataQuery for other
features (such as charts) to use SQL results.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
